chars.HUSBAND: a Moroccan man about 30 with a short black beard, wearing a navy zip work jacket with orange reflective stripes and grey cargo trousers
chars.WIFE: a young Moroccan woman about 24, wearing a loose long beige abaya and a light-grey headscarf
chars.SISTER: a Moroccan university student about 20 with curly dark hair in a ponytail, wearing a bright mustard-yellow hoodie and blue jeans

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night, entrance hall of a big traditional Moroccan family house with zellige tiles. HUSBAND just back from a long trip, a travel bag at his feet, hugging WIFE warmly; WIFE's face over his shoulder looks frozen and worried; SISTER stands one step away with a teasing mischievous grin, pointing at them. Tension between WIFE and SISTER visible.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Same hallway. SISTER laughing and teasing, miming holding a phone to her ear with a wink toward WIFE; HUSBAND smiling, confused; WIFE beside him stiff, eyes wide.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot in the hallway: HUSBAND's smile fading as he turns to look at WIFE; WIFE's face has gone pale, she looks away nervously, clutching her abaya sleeve.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Night at a remote work site in the Moroccan Sahara desert, floodlights and electricity pylons, sand dunes behind. HUSBAND tired after a night shift, sitting on a crate, holding his phone and looking at it sadly, no answer.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Bedroom at night in a Moroccan house, dim lamp. WIFE sitting in bed holding the phone to her ear, pretending to yawn, eyes alert and sly, another phone face down on the blanket beside her.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan home kitchen in daytime, teapot on the stove. HUSBAND leaning close to SISTER, asking her something quietly and seriously; SISTER holding a mug, surprised and a bit uneasy.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Same kitchen. SISTER talking with wide eyes and hand gestures, explaining; HUSBAND listening, his jaw tense, fist clenched on the table.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Dark corridor of the Moroccan house late at night. SISTER in pajamas standing near a closed bedroom door, ear close to it, shocked expression; a faint blue phone glow leaks from under the door; a wall clock shows very late night.
